name: rpn_operand_order_bug
task: evaluate_rpn() pops the two operands for a binary operator in the wrong order: it assigns the first popped value (the right-hand operand) to 'a' and the second popped value (the left-hand operand) to 'b', then calls apply_operator(op, a, b). This gives correct results for + and * but wrong results for - and / (e.g. "6 2 -" evaluates as 2-6 instead of 6-2). Fix evaluate_rpn() so operands are passed to apply_operator in the correct left-to-right order. Do not change apply_operator() or the function signatures.
